name: ui-scroll-rolled
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent game UI keyframe, collapsed story scroll
Primary request: One small horizontal rolled parchment cylinder viewed straight-on, closed tightly, with chunky wooden knobs at both ends and a blank cream paper band in the center.
Input images: the attached sheep, gate, and patched sail are style references only.
Style/medium: deliberately primitive old Windows MS Paint mouse doodle matching the references; heavy true-black jagged stair-stepped outline; clumsy lopsided silhouette; flat bucket fills; minimal uneven brown hatch marks.
Composition/framing: isolated centered object, wide 2:1 silhouette, large readable shapes, at least 12% clear margin.
Color palette: cream paper, mustard gold, brown wood, tiny dusty teal thread accent.
Constraints: actual transparent alpha background; no text, letters, icons, shadows, UI screenshot, characters, gradients, glossy light, polished vector curves, watermark. One object only.
